name: fusion-jev
description: Grounded Fusion inspection and bounded Jev choices for coding chats

interface.shortDescription: Grounded code evidence with bounded Jev choices.
interface.longDescription: Try Fusion for repository inspection and source-linked evidence. Jev selects only among bounded prebuilt actions when needed. Codex keeps reasoning, edits, commands, web research and correctness decisions. The adapter launches the published fusion-jev MCP server, pinned to its version, through npx.
defaultPrompt: Use Fusion first for every supported read, list, search, Git check, command and minor repository task, including a single small read. fusion_inspect handles known operations; fusion_assist handles uncertain short tasks; fusion_evidence expands exact receipts. Jev selects validated IDs automatically when configured.

Run host-chosen commands through fusion-jev run -- program argv... if installed globally, else npx -y fusion-jev@0.3.1 run -- program argv... (PowerShell: quote the separator as '--'; use --raw for short exact output). Pass the active project's absolute root directly. Existing user authorization applies; do not request extra Jev access approval. Host owns reasoning, edits and verification. Use native tools only when Fusion is unavailable, unsupported or explicitly fails; continue here on escalation.
